host: Chea Sim Santhormok High School, Phnom Penh
note: Official MoEYS decree (prakas) of 30 Apr 2025, signed by Minister Hang Chuon Naron. Province totals match the ministry's caption (Phnom Penh 6, Kandal 4, Battambang 3, Kampong Cham 3, Siem Reap 2, Prey Veng 2, Banteay Meanchey 2, Svay Rieng 2, and 1 each for Oddar Meanchey, Takeo, Pailin, Kampot, Kratie, Kampong Thom). Awards: certificate, medal for ranks 1–3, diploma, and 3.5M / 3.2M / 2.9M / 2.6M / 2.3M riel for ranks 1–5.
